title: SP-Anon
summary: A Python library of anonymization algorithms (k-anonymity, l-diversity, differential privacy, etc.) for health-related datasets. Its synthetic data module optionally wraps SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and CopulaGANSynthesizer via SingleTableMetadata to generate privacy-preserving synthetic tabular data as an alternative anonymization technique.
evidence: src/sp_anon/synthetic/generator.py:19-20 imports CopulaGANSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table; generator.py:93-104 instantiates them
